messages.subject: [camtrapR] Record table error on Mac using external drive
messages.subject_clean: [camtrapR] Record table error on Mac using external drive
messages.body_plain:
Hello and apologies if this message is redundant,

I am setting up a new digiKam/camtrapR workflow on a Macbook after using it successfully on a Windows machine for some time and have run into an issue. When running the record table command for videos stored on an external drive, I receive this error message:

"Warning: station directory /Volumes/Drive1/1234/01-2022/ was not found in digiKam albums. Skipping"

I assume there is some discrepancy in how the files are being accessed by digikam vs camtrapR, but the file paths appear identical (my inDir is set to "/Volumes/Drive1/1234" and the file path provided within digiKam is "/Volumes/Drive1/1234"). I have no issues running the same script on windows or when extracting metadata from video files stored locally on the mac. The error only occurs when extracting tags from media stored on an external drive using the mac.

Everything is up to date, and the issue is the same for the regular, CRAN download and the github version. I am really at a loss of what to try next and would appreciate any help.

Thanks so much!
